title: NixoCraft 5
description: The official modpack for NixoCraft 5, hosted by fienix_and_izio. Features high-performance optimization, quality-of-life improvements, and essential tools for the community server.
body:
![nixocraft 5 logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f32fce02e151948b7ac09262c4480e15dd55d8de.png)

This is the official modpack for the NixoCraft 5 project hosted by the streamer duo "fienix_and_izio".

### Features:
- Boost your FPS and reduce lag using Sodium.
- Navigate the world easily with Xaero's Minimap.
- Communicate with other players using Simple Voice Chat.
- Experience better visuals with Iris Shaders.

All of these mods are explicitly allowed for use on the NixoCraft 5 server. If there are any other mods you'd like to use, please visit our [FAQ](https://www.nixocraft.de/faq/) for further information.
